note: CANONICAL, hand-curated catalogue structure. Contains names, groupings, aliases and source references only. Coordinates of named features are NOT typed here: they are resolved at build time from the USGS/IAU Gazetteer export (data/raw/phase4/gazetteer_catalog.json) or, for analysis windows, from the Phase III pipeline (data/raw/phase3/resolved.json). Fingerprints come only from the pipeline outputs.

regions.name: Jezero / Isidis region
regions.description: Western margin of the Isidis basin: Jezero crater, its inlet valley and the Nili Fossae / Syrtis Major area.

regions.name: Gale / Aeolis region
regions.description: Gale crater with its central mound Aeolis Mons (Mount Sharp) and the Aeolis Mensae terrain to the east.

regions.name: Elysium region
regions.description: Elysium Planitia lowland plain and the Elysium Mons volcanic rise.

regions.name: Utopia Planitia
regions.description: Large northern lowland basin plain.

regions.name: Gusev / Ma'adim region
regions.description: Gusev crater and the Ma'adim Vallis channel that enters it from the south.

regions.name: Hellas basin
regions.description: Floor of the Hellas impact basin.

regions.name: Valles Marineris system
regions.description: The Valles Marineris canyon system and Noctis Labyrinthus at its western end.

regions.name: Tharsis volcanic province
regions.description: Olympus Mons and the Tharsis Montes shield volcanoes.

regions.name: Arcadia–Amazonis plains
regions.description: Northern and western lowland plains between Tharsis and Elysium, with the Medusae Fossae formation.

regions.name: Meridiani / Terra Sabaea
regions.description: Meridiani Planum, Endeavour crater and the Schiaparelli basin.

regions.name: Chryse / Oxia region
regions.description: Chryse Planitia, Ares Vallis, Oxia Planum and Mawrth Vallis.

regions.name: Argyre basin
regions.description: Floor of the Argyre impact basin.

regions.name: North polar region
regions.description: Planum Boreum north polar layered deposits.

regions.name: South polar region
regions.description: Planum Australe south polar layered deposits.

regions.name: South polar region
regions.description: Polar craters and massifs within ~15° of the south pole, and the Schrödinger basin on the far side.

regions.name: North polar region
regions.description: Craters around the lunar north pole.

regions.name: Oceanus Procellarum and volcanic terrains
regions.description: The largest lunar mare and the volcanic features within it.

regions.name: Nearside maria
regions.description: Major nearside mare basins.

regions.name: Apollo exploration sites
regions.description: Landing regions of Apollo 14–17, anchored at the NSSDCA LM coordinates.

regions.name: Basins, craters and tectonic terrains
regions.description: Orientale basin, young rayed craters and the Ina feature.
